column1: # Agility Pyramid (Wiki "Agility Pyramid": 30 Agility, obstacle xp, completion bonus 300 + 8/level capped at 1,000).
# Loc positions: decoded from the cache map (squares 52_44 main pyramid, 47_73 level 4 + top). The same loc type is
# placed many times, so rows are keyed by loc name + the loc's own tile. Crossing ends (a/b) follow the hotspot
# footprints and are guesses to confirm in game; the player is moved to whichever end is further away.
# Coords are x,z,plane; "*" keeps the player's current x or z.
# obstacle <loc> <loc tile> <xp> <anim> <ticks> <end a> <end b> <fail class: cross|jump> <on fail: fall|hurt> <damage>
# Level 1 (plane 1): north along the west side, east along the north, south down the east, west along the south.
# Level 3 -> level 4: the plane-3 stairs lead into the separate upper area (3034-3055, 4687-4705).
# Top (upper area, plane 3): climbing rocks (pyramid top, Pyramid.kt) and the doorway down are scripted.
